CHANGER'S DAWN FPS

PC build v0.5.1 · 5 modes · 3 bot difficulty levels · soldier and monster models from your blockout pack

WASD move · Shift sprint · Space jump · Mouse look · Left click fire · Right click aim · R reload · E plant/defuse · 1-5 pick weapon class (press again to cycle) · Q or wheel next weapon (24 weapons) · G graphics · Esc pause

Gun sounds: recorded samples, CC BY 3.0 by Vincent Sevedge.

Weapon models (CC BY 4.0, license): "low-poly AAC Honey Badger" by D.U.; "low-poly ADAR 2-15" by D_U; "low-poly AK-12 SK" by D_U; "low-poly AK-19" by D_U; "low-poly Colt M4A1" by D_U; "low-poly Colt M5 SCW" by D_U; "low-poly DD4 X1" by D_U; "low-poly FN M16A4" by D_U; "low-poly HK MR762" by D_U; "low-poly M110 SASS" by D_U; "low-poly UAR-10" by D_U; "low-poly UAR15 S1" by D_U; "Low Poly 3D Magnum Revolver" by nebula075; "Fn P90 Silencer Subfusil" by darman_clone. Models were simplified, recolored and re-assembled for this game.
